name: Interco Easy Product Creation
author: interconecta

sections.description:
Interco Easy Product Creation simplifies the process of creating WooCommerce products with an intuitive step-by-step wizard.

Instead of navigating the complex WooCommerce product editor, your team can create products in minutes using a guided flow that covers all the essentials.

Features

  • Step-by-step wizard – Guided product creation in 7-9 simple steps
  • Simple products – Set name, description, price, images, categories, tags, and inventory
  • Variable products – Define attributes (size, color, etc.) and generate all variations automatically
  • Chip-based attribute values – Add attribute values one by one with a simple text field and button (no special characters needed)
  • Bulk pricing – Apply the same price to all variations at once
  • Inline creation – Create new categories, tags, and attributes without leaving the wizard
  • Image management – Upload main image and gallery images using the WordPress media library
  • Live review – See a complete summary before publishing
  • Draft or publish – Choose to save as draft or publish immediately
  • HPOS compatible – Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage

Who is this for?

  • Store owners who find the default WooCommerce product editor overwhelming
  • Teams with non-technical staff who need to add products regularly
  • Anyone who wants a faster, simpler way to create WooCommerce products

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Upload the interco-easy-product-creation folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Interco Easy Product Creation to start creating products.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated. The plugin will display a notice if WooCommerce is not found.

Can I create variable products with multiple attributes?

Yes. You can add as many attributes as needed (e.g., Size, Color, Material) and the wizard will generate all possible combinations automatically.

Does it support global WooCommerce attributes?

Yes. You can select existing global attributes from the dropdown, and their existing terms will be pre-populated. You can also create new global attributes directly from the wizard.

Is it compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes, the plugin declares full compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS / Custom Order Tables.

Can I set a sale price for variations?

Yes. Each variation has fields for regular price, sale price, SKU, and stock. You can also use the bulk pricing feature to apply the same price to all variations at once.

Does the plugin store any data I should know about?

No. The plugin only creates standard WooCommerce products using the WooCommerce API. It does not create custom database tables or store additional data.
